intro.h2: A remodel you can follow from start date to cleanup
paragraphs: Bancroft Kitchen & Bath handles kitchen and bath remodeling in Yorktown, VA, from countertops and tile backsplash to full bathroom renovations. Clients notice the organization first: firm start dates that are kept, a production schedule notebook on day one, and updates every week.

That structure works even in tough settings. One couple in a high rise condo could only have work done between 8:30 AM and 5 PM, and our crew started on time and cleaned up each day. Another owner needed his Outer Banks kitchen finished before his first renters arrived, and Gerald and Haley sent photos and texts until it was done.

services.h2: Kitchen and bath work we handle

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Full kitchen updates with new cabinets, countertops, backsplash and lighting. One family has used Bancroft on three local kitchens and two in the Outer Banks, and says they now have beautiful kitchens. Rental owners on a deadline have also relied on us.

image.alt: Open kitchen with oversized granite island, island range hood, charcoal shaker cabinets and oak floor

items.name: Quartz and granite countertops
items.blurb: Gerald comes to your home to measure, brings samples and helps with material and color choices. Our installers set the countertops and leave the kitchen clean and tidy. We also replace countertops on their own when the cabinets are staying.

image.alt: Cherry cabinet kitchen with granite countertops, tile backsplash, stainless refrigerator and pendant lights

items.name: Tile backsplash
items.blurb: A new backsplash ties the countertop to the cabinets. We help you pick tile and color to go with your quartz or granite, then our tile installers finish the job. One client says the countertop and tile installers did a great job and were pleasant to work with.

image.alt: Honey oak kitchen with granite counters, tiled backsplash, glass-front cabinet and stained glass pendant over the table

items.name: Bathroom renovations
items.blurb: We renovate bathrooms with the same start dates and weekly updates we use for kitchens. One condo owner had two bathrooms renovated by Bancroft and says the employees were considerate and talented and cleaned up after each day.

items.name: Flooring, trim and fireplaces
items.blurb: Remodels often reach past the kitchen. We have replaced flooring and baseboards throughout a condo and fabricated an electric fireplace surround for the same clients, coordinating our own employees and trusted subcontractors on one schedule.

image.alt: No flooring or fireplace photo available yet

items.name: Bar and commercial counters
items.blurb: Our Google photos include a long bar with a stone countertop, a raised bar rail and a row of stools. If you are updating a bar, a rental property or a second home, call and ask what we can take on.

image.alt: Long bar with stone countertop, wood paneling and leather bar stools in front of back-bar shelving

about.text: Bancroft Kitchen & Bath is a kitchen and bath contractor with a showroom at 6605 George Washington Memorial Hwy in Yorktown. Clients usually meet Gerald, who visits to measure and bring samples, and Haley. Together they keep clients updated with photos and texts while the work goes on. Our own team works alongside subcontractors that a reviewer called exceptional. We are open about price too. As one client put it, you can find contractors who charge less, but he did not believe they could match the quality, and he felt his work was reasonably priced.

steps.title: Visit and samples
steps.text: Gerald comes to your home to measure, give advice and bring samples so you can choose countertops, tile and colors in your own light.

steps.title: Start date
steps.text: You get a start date before work begins. Clients say Bancroft always started on time, even with building rules limiting work hours.

steps.title: Production schedule notebook
steps.text: When the job starts you receive a production schedule notebook, and we update you each week, with photos and texts when you are away.

steps.title: Install and daily cleanup
steps.text: Our employees and installers do the work and clean up at the end of each day, leaving your kitchen or bathroom tidy.

steps.title: Finished space
steps.text: We wrap up the countertop, tile, bathroom or flooring work and hand the room back ready to use, in time for family or renters.

items.name: Robert N.
items.text:
We've had Bancroft K&B renovate two bathrooms, replace flooring and baseboards, replace kitchen counter tops and fabricate an electric fireplace. We live in a high rise condo with many restrictions. No work before 8.30 AM, out by 5 PM.
Bancroft gave us start dates and always started on time. Upon start, the customer is provided with a production schedule notebook and updates each week. Employees are considerate, talented and clean up after each day. Their subcontractors are also exceptional.
I'm sure you can find numerous contractors that will do the renovations for less, but I don't believe they can provide the quality. I do believe our work was reasonably priced.

items.name: Kathy T.
items.text: From start to finish, Gerald and Haley made our kitchen update a success!! Their professionalism and expert advice guided us through materials and color selection of quartz countertops and tile backsplash. Gerald's visits to our home to measure, advise, provide suggestions and samples convinced us that Bancroft would be a company we could trust to do the job well. The countertop and tile installers did a great job, were pleasant to work with and left our kitchen clean and tidy as they completed their jobs! We love our updated kitchen and without hesitation will recommend Bancroft to others!

items.name: Lloyd J.
items.text: Bancroft saved the day on my kitchen remodel in the OBX.  They had everything I needed and went above and beyond to get my kitchen job completed in time for the arrival of my first renters.  Gerald and Haley were so wonderful to work with and kept me updated with photos and texts the whole time.  My family has used Bancroft on 3local and 2 OBX jobs and they’ve never let us down.  We now have beautiful kitchens and highly recommend them to all.

service_area.h2: Kitchen and bath remodeling in Yorktown, VA and the Outer Banks
service_area.text: Our showroom is at 6605 George Washington Memorial Hwy in Yorktown, Virginia, and most of our work is local to Yorktown. We have also completed kitchen remodels in the Outer Banks of North Carolina for clients with second homes and rentals there. If you are not sure whether your project is in range, call (757) 988-1100 and ask. You can also stop by the Yorktown showroom on weekdays between 8 AM and 4 PM to talk it through.

items.a: Kitchens and bathrooms. That includes quartz and granite countertops, tile backsplash, full bathroom renovations, flooring and baseboards. For one condo client we also fabricated an electric fireplace. Our photos show kitchens with granite islands and a stone-topped bar as well.

items.q: How will I know what is happening on my job?
items.a: You get a start date before work begins and a production schedule notebook when the job starts, with updates each week. If you are not on site, as with an Outer Banks rental, Gerald and Haley can keep you updated with photos and texts.

items.q: Can you work in a condo with building rules?
items.a: Yes. One client lives in a high rise condo where no work is allowed before 8:30 AM and everyone must be out by 5 PM. They say Bancroft always started on time and cleaned up after each day, across two bathrooms, floors, counters and a fireplace.

items.q: Where are you and when are you open?
items.a: We are at 6605 George Washington Memorial Hwy, Yorktown, VA 23692. Hours are Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 4 PM, and we are closed on weekends. Call (757) 988-1100 or email haley@bancroftgranite.com to set up a visit. You can also stop by the showroom during those hours.
